When the alarm didn;t ring one early Saturday mornning as my roommate slept, a wave rushed of guilt as i rushed through to her room in her dormitory, to see the culprit. It had all been too much to process in one go, the guilt at not getting an alarm clock working and not telling a roommate that i didn’t like the smell. The guilt and anxiety of waking a friend in that manner had all combined for one overwhelming emotion that left no room to breathe, until she woke me to apologize and say "its all okay" and i finally relaxed a little.

Learning that moment, from what I thought a very big and embarrassing slip-up was in hindsight not the case was something that has stayed on as a very personal and memorable experience of the power a single sentence, or a kind gesture could mean for both giving someone the strength, to face an error, yet at that point also not being alone.
